accreditation.headline: Press accreditation.
accreditation.body: Media accreditation opens ahead of each ODDfest and ODDference edition. Get in touch with press below to be notified when the next round opens.

keyFacts.label: 2026 event dates
keyFacts.value: ODDfest Fri–Sat, June 12–13, 2026 · ODDference Thu–Fri, June 11–12, 2026 · Creative Week Mon–Sun, June 8–14, 2026

keyFacts.label: Location
keyFacts.value: Multiple iconic locations across central Helsinki, including Lasipalatsi, Kulttuurikasarmi, Tavastia Club, Semifinal, Kamppi Chapel, and Vanha Ylioppilastalo

keyFacts.label: Program curators
keyFacts.value: Minna Tervamäki, Suvi Honkanen, Otto Kylmälä, Pihla Viitala, Johanna Oras, Jonas Verwijnen, Ukko-Pekka Itäpelto, Emmi Kärnä, Karoliina Jarenko, and Elisabet Lahti

keyFacts.label: Mission
keyFacts.value: To make creative economy the next big engine of sustainable growth in Finland, put local creativity on the map, and celebrate global oddity

boilerplate.headline: ODD, in one paragraph.
boilerplate.body: ODD is a Helsinki-based platform working to strengthen Finland's creative economy by connecting creative professionals, organisations and communities through events, spaces and projects. Its work includes ODDfest, ODDference, ODDspace and project-based collaborations. ODD is operated by New Nordic Way rf.
